result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but there is a noticeable navigation-state inconsistency and some horizontally scrolling content is clipped at the right edge, which can look broken. No critical blockers are visible.

issues.description: Bottom navigation highlights Profile as active while the visible content is the Home feed.
issues.suggestion: Sync the selected tab state with the current route so Home is highlighted on this screen.

issues.description: Category chips and Fastest near you cards are cut off at the right edge, including a partially visible chip and truncated restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...'.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer edge fade/scroll affordance or ensure peeking content is intentionally padded so truncation looks deliberate.

issues.description: Small metadata text such as delivery fees, time ranges, and cuisine labels may be low contrast or too small for some users.
issues.suggestion: Increase minimum font size and verify contrast ratios for secondary text against card/image backgrounds.
